verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a built-in AI Assistant in the Dashboard that generates schema SQL, diagnoses SQL errors, and gives table-specific recommendations. It also offers a direct delegation path: you can have the Assistant generate and deploy Edge Functions ("Deploy a new function > Via AI Assistant"). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-dashboard assistant, documentation of how far it can act autonomously beyond SQL generation and function deployment, and any limits or approval controls for its actions.
